items.summary:
Sisters Jinger Duggar and Joy-Anna Duggar are getting candid about how their family’s strict modesty guidelines affected their respective body image.

“Obviously, we were raised in the same house, but I think that we both have different perspectives on a lot of things just because you were in the older half, I was somewhat in the younger half,” Joy-Anna, 29, told Jinger, 32, on the Wednesday, November 25, episode of their “Call Your Sister” podcast . “I definitely had a lot of body issues from going through puberty. I think that’s very normal.”

While Joy-Anna admittedly felt “so self-conscious” about her changing body, her parents’ rules also played a factor. ( Jim Bob and Michelle Duggar raised their 19 children following the IBLP religion, which had specific rules about modesty in girls’ clothing.)

“I do think that being so strict on modesty definitely added a layer of almost being ashamed of how God had made me, and that God did give me breasts and that I did have a bum,” she acknowledged. “Those things are normal, and so I think that I did struggle a lot.”

Why Sisters Jinger and Joy-Anna Duggar Weren’t Close Growing Up 

According to Joy-Anna, Michelle, 60, was “really good” about normalizing her kids’ bodies.

“I did take that as I need to cover up in modesty,” Joy-Anna said. “I took it to the extreme of, ‘This is a bad thing and I need to hide it and I’m ashamed that I’m growing and that I’m changing.’”

Jinger, who has been vocal about her past disordered eating habits , also felt disheartened that her family seldom discussed their bodies.

“I think there were…
items.t: Jinger and Joy-Anna Duggar Recall Body Image Struggles Amid Modesty Rules

Jin Yu was found dead with trauma to her face and neck in her home in the Chinatown neighborhood on November 20, according to a criminal complaint viewed by ABC 7 . Yu’s roommate, a 66-year-old man, was also attacked during the incident.

The New York Police Department has since arrested Alexander Florentino for allegedly attacking both of the victims.

The NYPD said in a statement that authorities learned about the attacks while responding to a 911 call around 3 p.m. on November 20. Once officers reported to the scene, they found Yu, 62, “unconscious and unresponsive with trauma to the face and neck.”

Meanwhile, her roommate had a cut on his face after he was struck over his head with a glass bottle. The NYPD told Us that the man was taken to NYC Health + Hospitals/Bellevue for treatment and is now in stable condition.

Florentino, 25, has since been charged with three separate counts of murder – sexual abuse and forcible compulsion – two separate counts of strangulation and three separate counts of burglary among 14 charges.

His online records indicate that he was also charged with child endangerment. However, it’s not currently clear whether a child was present at the time of the attack or if that charge was connected to the recent crime.

items.title: Man Flew From France to Nebraska to Kill Woman He Once Went on a Date With
items.summary:
A man has been accused of flying from France to Nebraska to kill a childcare worker he had gone on one date with three years earlier.

Terry Kanmacher has been arrested after he allegedly stabbed Lauren Becker to death. Kenmacher, 21, was caught while trying to board a plane at a Minnesota airport to head home to his native country of France.

Omaha Police Chief Todd Schmaderer said during a press conference that Kanmacher allegedly attacked Becker, 22, outside Kids Can Community Center in Omaha on Tuesday, November 24, around 9:15 a.m.

Kanmacher arrived in Omaha on Sunday, November 22. Schmaderer said Kanmacher left his Airbnb two days later and waited in the childcare center’s parking lot for about 45 minutes before attacking Becker as she walked to work.

Couple Arrested in School Employee's Death Hid in Mexico 'For Months' 

Becker and Kanmacher previously connected online, and they met only one time in prison when he flew to Omaha in the summer of 2023. Becker ended their communication in December 2023 and reportedly made it clear she did not see a future with him.

“The victim was very clear in 2023 that the relationship was over,” Schmaderer said, per Nebraska Public Media . “She was afraid of him at this point. She came to the police department and she reported her concerns. Her concerns were very detail oriented, and a lot of her concerns mirrored what took place, quite frankly.”

Three years later, Kanmacher allegedly traveled to Omaha with plans to kill Becker.

Kanmacher was arrested on Tuesday at the Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport while trying…
items.t: Man Flew From France to Nebraska to Kill Woman He Once Went on a Date With
